mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 77 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Reddan Soccer Park. The waning crescent moon is out, and the space station will be visible tonight starting at 9:05 PM, rising in the Southwest over Mount Horeb and heading toward the East Northeast over the Fitchburg and Madison area for 2 minutes. The overnight low will be 61 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Police Department has arrested 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019. The school district notified police on August 30th, leading to an arrest on September 4th.

There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can check out trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. On Tuesday, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, the Downtown Farmer's Market, and more trivia at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On Sunday, August 30th, the Verona Police Department was informed by the school district of an inappropriate relationship between a staff member and a student from 2019, which led to the recent arrest of the individual involved.
Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM, so make sure to stop by and try today's delicious Georgia Peach flavor of the day.
